caption: The drawing features a doll in a front-facing view, wearing a long, light-colored dress with subtle polka dots. The dress has red trim around the collar, cuffs, and near the hem, as well as red-bordered buttons running down the center. The dress extends to the floor and ends in a ruffled hem. The doll has short, black, curly hair and a painted face with blue eyes and red lips. To the right of the main image, there is a smaller rear view of the same doll, showing the back of the dress, which also features the ruffled hem and a seam that runs down the back. The background is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects or decorations present. In the lower left corner, there is a handwritten signature and a date.
title: Doll
